# Command line

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py -- do not edit. Run `make generate` after changing its source. -->

Every command answers `--help`. A refusal a person can act on -- a setting, a scope, a token, the daemon -- is one line on stderr and exit status 1. `simtrail --version` prints the version.

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `simtrail serve` | Run the Simtrail daemon on 127.0.0.1 |
| `simtrail mcp` | Serve the agent tools over stdio, for an MCP client |
| `simtrail open` | Open this project's simulator viewer in the browser |
| `simtrail stop` | Stop a project's device session, and the daemon when asked |
| `simtrail doctor` | Check this Mac for what Simtrail needs |
| `simtrail config` | Show or change Simtrail's settings |
| `simtrail config path` | Print where config.toml is |
| `simtrail config validate` | Check config.toml and the SIMTRAIL_ environment |
| `simtrail config scope` | Print the scope id Simtrail gives a folder |
| `simtrail config list` | Every setting and its value |
| `simtrail config get` | One setting's value |
| `simtrail config set` | Set a setting in config.toml |
| `simtrail config unset` | Remove a setting from config.toml |
| `simtrail config copy` | Copy one scope's own settings into another scope's table |
| `simtrail settings` | Confirm a settings change a page asked for |
| `simtrail settings confirm` | Show each sensitive change waiting, and the code that confirms it |
| `simtrail devices` | List this Mac's simulators, real devices and Android devices, or choose one |
| `simtrail devices list` | List the devices a project could use (the default) |
| `simtrail devices choose` | Use this device for a project from now on |
| `simtrail device` | Change how a project's device looks, or where it believes it is |
| `simtrail device appearance` | Light or dark |
| `simtrail device status-bar` | A demo status bar, or the device's own |
| `simtrail device location` | Where the device believes it is |
| `simtrail device clear-location` | The device's own location again |
| `simtrail device text-size` | Its text size |
| `simtrail device contrast` | Increased contrast |
| `simtrail device reduce-motion` | Reduce motion, on a real device |
| `simtrail record` | Record a project's device as an MP4 or a GIF |
| `simtrail record start` | Start recording the device |
| `simtrail record stop` | Stop recording and keep it |
| `simtrail record list` | Name the recordings kept (the default) |
| `simtrail token` | Make, list or revoke the daemon's scoped tokens |
| `simtrail token create` | Make a token; it is printed only this once |
| `simtrail token list` | List the scoped tokens |
| `simtrail token revoke` | Stop accepting a token |
| `simtrail tools` | List the agent tools this install offers |
| `simtrail xcode` | Let Simtrail use Xcode 27's tools |
| `simtrail xcode approve` | Open a project through Xcode's tools, which is when Xcode approves Simtrail |
| `simtrail helper` | Build the native helper, or say which one is used |
| `simtrail helper status` | Say which native helper is used, and whether it can be |
| `simtrail helper build` | Build the native helper with Xcode for this version of Simtrail |
| `simtrail helper sign` | Make this Mac's signing certificate for the helper, once, so Screen Recording and Accessibility granted to it are kept across upgrades (macOS asks for your password to trust it) |
| `simtrail app` | See what an app shares through Simtrail's debug SDK |
| `simtrail app hierarchy` | Print the view hierarchy the app in front shares |
| `simtrail wda` | Set up WebDriverAgent to touch, type on and read a real device |
| `simtrail wda status` | Say what is set up for WebDriverAgent, and whether it touches the running device now |
| `simtrail wda teams` | List the development teams this Mac can sign WebDriverAgent with |
| `simtrail wda setup` | Fetch WebDriverAgent and build it with your team |
| `simtrail wda uninstall` | Remove WebDriverAgent from a device |
| `simtrail android` | Set up and inspect Android emulators and phones |
| `simtrail android status` | Say what is set up for Android devices (the default) |
| `simtrail android avds` | List the Android virtual devices made with the SDK |
| `simtrail android setup` | Fetch scrcpy's server, to see an Android device live and touch it fast |
| `simtrail android clean` | Remove what Simtrail left on the Android devices adb lists |
| `simtrail version` | Print the package, protocol and connector versions |

## `simtrail serve`

Run the Simtrail daemon on 127.0.0.1.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--port PORT` | the port to listen on, instead of server.port |
| `--config CONFIG` | the config.toml to read, instead of the usual one |
| `--detach` | start it in the background and return |
| `--foreground` | run it in this process (the default) |

## `simtrail mcp`

Serve the agent tools over stdio, for an MCP client.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | the scope to drive, instead of this folder's project |
| `--root ROOT` | a folder builds and installs may reach; repeatable (default: here) |
| `--label LABEL` | name this session for viewers and other agents, such as a ticket (default: SIMTRAIL_AGENT_LABEL) |

## `simtrail open`

Open this project's simulator viewer in the browser.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | the scope to show, instead of this folder's project |
| `--print` | print the URL instead of opening it |
| `--settings` | let this page change the project's settings |
| `--device UDID` | show this device in the tab, instead of following the project's own |

## `simtrail stop`

Stop a project's device session, and the daemon when asked.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | for this scope, instead of this folder's project |
| `--device UDID` | let this device go for every scope using it, instead of only this project's (it keeps running) |
| `--shutdown` | shut its simulator or emulator down too (never a real device) |
| `--daemon` | stop the Simtrail daemon too, unless it serves others |
| `--force` | with --shutdown or --daemon: go ahead even while other scopes use it |

## `simtrail doctor`

Check this Mac for what Simtrail needs.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | print the report as JSON |
| `--no-tap` | skip the real test tap on a simulator |
| `--device DEVICE` | the simulator (UDID) to tap, instead of a booted one |

## `simtrail config`

Show or change Simtrail's settings.

It takes no arguments.

## `simtrail config path`

Print where config.toml is.

It takes no arguments.

## `simtrail config validate`

Check config.toml and the SIMTRAIL_ environment.

It takes no arguments.

## `simtrail config scope`

Print the scope id Simtrail gives a folder.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--folder FOLDER` | this folder instead of the current one |

## `simtrail config list`

Every setting and its value.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | as this scope sees it |

## `simtrail config get`

One setting's value.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NAME` | a setting, such as stream.fps |
| `--scope SCOPE` | as this scope sees it |

## `simtrail config set`

Set a setting in config.toml.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NAME` |  |
| `VALUE` |  |
| `--scope SCOPE` | in this scope's own table |

## `simtrail config unset`

Remove a setting from config.toml.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NAME` |  |
| `--scope SCOPE` | from this scope's own table |

## `simtrail config copy`

Copy one scope's own settings into another scope's table.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--from SCOPE` | the scope to copy from |
| `--scope SCOPE` | the scope to copy into; what it sets already is kept |

## `simtrail record`

Record a project's device as an MP4 or a GIF.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | for this scope, instead of this folder's project |

## `simtrail record start`

Start recording the device.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--format FORMAT` | what to keep, instead of recording.format (one of: mp4, gif, both) |
| `--width PIXELS` | how wide the files are, 240 to 1200, instead of the settings |
| `--quality QUALITY` | the MP4's bitrate, instead of recording.mp4_quality (one of: low, medium, high) |
| `--fps FPS` | frames a second in the MP4, instead of recording.fps (one of: 30, 60, 120) |
| `--preset PRESET` | settings made for one place: pr is an MP4 a pull request plays (one of: pr) |
| `--also ALSO` | also keep a copy as this preset, beside the recording (one of: pr) |
| `--max-seconds SECONDS` | stop by itself after this long, 5 to 3600, instead of recording.max_seconds |
| `--label TEXT` | joined into the file name: letters and digits, the rest dashes |
| `--scope SCOPE` | for this scope, instead of this folder's project |

## `simtrail record stop`

Stop recording and keep it.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | for this scope, instead of this folder's project |

## `simtrail record list`

Name the recordings kept (the default).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | for this scope, instead of this folder's project |

## `simtrail token`

Make, list or revoke the daemon's scoped tokens.

It takes no arguments.

## `simtrail token create`

Make a token; it is printed only this once.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--kind KIND` |  (one of: agent, viewer, admin, host) |
| `--scope SCOPE` | a scope id, a namespace such as notes:*, or * for all; repeatable |
| `--label LABEL` | what the token is for |
| `--root ROOT` | a folder an agent or host token may reach; repeatable |

## `simtrail token list`

List the scoped tokens.

It takes no arguments.

## `simtrail token revoke`

Stop accepting a token.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ID` |  |

## `simtrail tools`

List the agent tools this install offers.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | print the manifest an MCP client receives |

## `simtrail xcode`

Let Simtrail use Xcode 27's tools.

It takes no arguments.

## `simtrail xcode approve`

Open a project through Xcode's tools, which is when Xcode approves Simtrail.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `PROJECT` | the .xcodeproj or .xcworkspace to open; default: this folder's |
| `--scope SCOPE` | use this scope's Xcode, instead of this folder's project's |

## `simtrail helper`

Build the native helper, or say which one is used.

It takes no arguments.

## `simtrail helper status`

Say which native helper is used, and whether it can be.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | print it as JSON |
| `--scope SCOPE` | for this scope's settings, instead of this folder's project's |

## `simtrail helper build`

Build the native helper with Xcode for this version of Simtrail.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--force` | build it even when a usable one is already built |
| `--scope SCOPE` | build with this scope's Xcode, instead of this folder's project's |

## `simtrail helper sign`

Make this Mac's signing certificate for the helper, once, so Screen Recording and Accessibility granted to it are kept across upgrades (macOS asks for your password to trust it).

It takes no arguments.

## `simtrail app`

See what an app shares through Simtrail's debug SDK.

It takes no arguments.

## `simtrail app hierarchy`

Print the view hierarchy the app in front shares.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--device DEVICE` | the simulator (UDID) to read, instead of the one booted |
| `--scope SCOPE` | use this scope's connectors.app settings, instead of this folder's |
| `--json` | print it as JSON |
